enchantments.tooltip: Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +20 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Quality Deception +2: +2 Quality bonus to hit and +3 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Doubleshot 8%: Passive: 8% Enhancement bonus to Doubleshot. (Doubleshot is a chance to score an additional hit with a ranged attack.)
Insightful Dodge +6%: +6% Insightful bonus to Dodge.
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
